Awards & Achievements

International Commerce Centre (ICC) became the tallest building in Asia certified by WiredScore

Kai Shing Management Services Limited (Kai Shing) is committed to promoting smart technology in its properties. Recently, International Commerce Centre (ICC) managed by Kai Shing became the tallest building in Asia to obtain a Platinum Cerification, the highest certification from WiredScore, validating ICC is having advanced digital infrastructure in the world, which is able to support tenants with the most stringent technology requirements for their current and future needs.

This also marks the third property to achieve such certification, following The Millennity and a commercial development project above Hong Kong’s West Kowloon Station of the Express Rail Link which will be completed shortly. With the world-class infrastructure of the building. ICC can flexibly accommodate various high-end communication networks and equipment. During the early stage of operation, ICC's office building was a pioneer to equip with multiple fiber entry points, ensuring seamless and flexible broadband connections, where tenants can choose telecommunication servce providers whatever they want.

Additionally, ICC deploys stringent security systems to maintain the digital communication equipment of the entire building, including backup power to mitigate the risk of telecommunication disruptions and enhance the overall communication stability of the property. With these measures and facilities, all tenants are able to enjoy a more stable digital connectivity experience in ICC.

The achievement of receiving the highest certification from WiredScore not only reaffirms the property and the team's capabilities in enhancing the property's digital network, but also confirms ICC is an ideal office building for companies to establish and expand their operations. The team will continue to optimize the facilities and digital communication solutions in the property, to provide customers with faster, more reliable, and seamless digital communication networks in higher quality.

Established in 2013, WiredScore is an international assessment company in assessing and improving digital connectivity and smart technology within properties around the world. To attain the Platinum Certification of WiredScore, the property must undergo assessments in various categories, including the connectivity, infrastructure, tenant experience, mobility, service providers and future readiness regarding digital communication.
